Everything else is unchanged: the same tight three-change replacement in p0077 (mutuality, deletion of the Sections 3, 4, 7 and 11 restriction, new fee/USD limbs) plus the single insertion carrying the carve-out list and the mutual indirect/consequential exclusion.
